title: On the triviality of direct image of coherent sheaves
summary: Let $π\,:\, X \,\longrightarrow\, Y$ be a finite morphism of projective varieties defined over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. We study the necessary and sufficient criteria for $π$ such that there exists a coherent sheaf $E$ on $X$ whose direct image $π_*E$ is a trivial vector bundle on $Y$ of positive rank. When $X$ is smooth, and $Y$ is Cohen-Macaulay, such a coherent sheaf is necessarily locally free.
